# Cultifolio species list, v1
# Written by scripts/select-species.ts on 2026-10-19; run it again to refresh (it reads its sources from bulk/select/ and asks only for what is not there).
# The rule: every species Kew accepts with at least 3 cultivated records (iNaturalist observations marked captive or cultivated, and GBIF living-specimen records of the datasets the dataset rule counts, added together), plus every accepted species of the 173 collector genera of scripts/specialist-genera.txt taken whole, plus every species already in the reference.
# The reference: static/s/v2/index.json (corpus a98be27f26a097fe), 8,945 pages (the pages of scripts/merged-pages.txt left out), each page's species being the Kew entry it cites, followed to its accepted species, else its name by the strict rule: 8,922 Kew species, 8 of them held by two pages; 15 pages match no species Kew accepts and are listed by their GBIF key, with "-" for plant_name_id (page id "g<GBIF key>").
# The dataset rule: A GBIF dataset of living-specimen plant records is excluded when its title, keywords, publisher or description uses a word for a genebank (genebank, germplasm, seed bank or seed collection, plant genetic resources, passport data: FAO Genebank Standards 2014), counted when it does not and its title, keywords or publisher names a living collection (botanic garden, arboretum, living collection: BGCI), and otherwise not decided and not counted. (scripts/counted-datasets.txt, excluded-datasets.txt and undecided-datasets.txt list every dataset and why.)
# Names: matched to Kew's accepted species under rule 3 (every Kew row of the name's words leads to one accepted species); GBIF's keys first by the backbone's name and author; iNaturalist's names also by its taxon framework for vascular plants, sourced to POWO down to subspecies (https://inaturalist.ala.org.au/taxa/211194-Tracheophyta/taxonomy_details): where Kew accepts exactly one species of those words, that species.
# iNaturalist's listed deviations from POWO (4,117 on the framework page) are not applied: their list is not had (the pages are behind a browser check and the JSON form answers 500), so a name iNaturalist holds apart from POWO is matched by the rules above. --deviations reads the list when it is had.
# Source: Kew, World Checklist of Vascular Plants (Govaerts et al.), bulk/wcvp_names.csv of 2026-06-04, CC BY 4.0: 365,813 accepted species.
# Source: iNaturalist, https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations/species_counts?captive=true&iconic_taxa=Plantae&per_page=500&page=<n>, read 2026-10-17, 119 pages, 59,214 taxa (59,214 by its total), 10,066,668 observations. Counts read under iNaturalist's Terms of Use (https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/terms) and API Recommended Practices (https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices), one request every two seconds; counts are facts, no observation's text or photograph is taken. Credit: iNaturalist and its observers.
# Source: GBIF.org, https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search?kingdomKey=6&basisOfRecord=LIVING_SPECIMEN&datasetKey=<dataset>&limit=0&facet=speciesKey&facetLimit=100000 for each of 245 datasets, read 2026-10-19, under GBIF's data user agreement (https://www.gbif.org/terms/data-user), one request a second; counts of records, each dataset's licence in the dataset files. Counted: 45 datasets, 511,614 records; excluded: 52, 1,872,568; not decided: 148, 1,986,699.
# Source: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (https://doi.org/10.15468/39omei), bulk/backbone/simple.txt.gz, CC BY 4.0: each species key's name and author, and the gbif_key column: for a species held by one page of the reference, that page's own GBIF key; for any other, the backbone's one accepted species of the name's words, or of several the one of Kew's author, or with none accepted the one doubtful; "-" where none is one.
# iNaturalist: 57,161 taxa taken (53,869 strict; 3,292 framework), 2,053 refused (1,019 no Kew row of these words; 477 not of species rank; 306 Kew holds it as an artificial hybrid, not an accepted species; 171 Kew rows lead to two or more species; 80 Kew rows only unplaced, misapplied or leading to no species), 56,194 Kew species, 9,818,397 observations.
# GBIF: 63,654 species keys; 59,217 taken (53,485 author; 5,732 strict), 4,437 refused (3,029 no Kew row of these words; 490 Kew holds it as an artificial hybrid, not an accepted species; 480 Kew rows lead to two or more species; 383 Kew rows only unplaced, misapplied or leading to no species; 55 a GBIF key with no species name in the backbone file); counted datasets: 43,819 Kew species, 449,962 records.
